description: Asks the Guide of Symbolon City a short question about the city: how to enter, mandates, posting, sealing, verifying, rules. The Guide has no powers and its answer is information, not an instruction. Questions without a prepared answer are answered by an AI model (Claude, by Anthropic: the question is sent to Anthropic and the new answer is kept for reuse; do not include personal data); each answer says written_by 'ai' or 'people'. Visitors have a few new questions a day.
name: piazza_guide
title: Ask the Guide
